_comment: Martial Hero 2 by LuizMelo -- Creative Commons Zero (CC-0). Licence text is
in LICENSE.txt beside this file; provenance is in docs/ASSETS.md.
This is p2's character. Two packs rather than one so a viewer can tell the
fighters apart at a glance -- the health bars say which is which, but a
Its frame counts are NOT the same as pack 1's: idle is 4 rather than 8,
attack1 and attack2 are 4 rather than 6, death is 7, take-hit is 3. That is
exactly why a clip names its own image and offset instead of the loader
assuming a uniform grid -- a real pack is whatever its author drew.
With only 4 attack frames the three Commitment Window phases overlap:
startup 0-1, active 1-2, recovery 2-3. Each phase still starts on a
different frame, so startup, active and recovery remain distinguishable,
which is the property that matters. special-active and special-recovery
share frames 2-3 outright -- attack2 has four frames and the phases need
3+2+2, so something has to give, and doubling the tail is more honest than
inventing a pose the artist never drew.
